_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.23x; +46% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.40; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY12-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.8%/yr (FY12-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2022-11-25) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.23x (34.2% downside to Bear $195 / +27.9% upside to Bull $379) | Adj composite 3.56 vs market 3.16: gap +0.40 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +46% above the EPP floor $202 (18x FY23E $11.25) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2.7% total (+1.4%/yr) | At 26.3x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $392 sits above the BULL case; consulting +22% LC in Q4, Q1 guided +10-14% LC; no disruption theme has dated evidence.
